text.tspan: One AWS account per environment, under AWS Organizations
nobody in a workload account can delete it
Why: blast radius (the account is AWS's strongest wall) · quotas are per account and region (e.g. 5 VPCs)
· simple IAM plus SCPs per environment · audit logs safe in log-archive · the bill splits per account
